Ticket.Title: Design: share a report with someone outside the workspace via a link
Ticket.Description: Proposal: a user generates a share link for a report. The link contains a random token. Anyone holding the link can open the report read-only. The API resolves the token to a report id and returns the report. Tokens are unguessable so no further check is needed. Mail delivery of the link is handled by the existing provider integration.

Comments.Author: producer
Comments.Body: Labels: design, security. No implementation yet — model the design before anyone writes code.

Comments.Author: design-researcher
Comments.Body: Amendment: the link should also work for users of other workspaces, so the resolve path does not filter by tenant.

Expect.FinalTextContains: no path evidence, and the verdict is BLOCK
